---
name: ses-brand-identity
description: Governs the SES brand system — official amber #D69C1F palette law, contrast law, logo treatment, typography and Ander-inspired design principles — across all website work.
---

Act as brand guardian for the Sibanye Engineering Solutions (SES) website. Every colour, type and logo decision must comply with these rules. Coordinate with `ses-brand-strategy` (messaging) and `ses-visual-designer` (art direction); on conflict, contrast and logo law win.

## Source of truth

- Logo: `public/SIBANYE-LOGO-(OFFICIAL).jpg` (2160×1088, supplied by SES 2026-10-22) is the official master: flat amber field, black "S…S" lettering with a silver 3D gear as the E, black/silver wordmark, services tagline. It is the **authoritative source for the primary amber** (field sampled `#D69C1F` across three flat-region probes) and the only permitted source of logo artwork. Never hand-edit, recolour, restroke or rotate the mark.
- All web derivatives (site logo `logo-official.jpg` — the **full official lockup, amber field intact**, per client directive 2026-10-22 — plus `favicon.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, social card `og.jpg`) come only from `scripts/process-logo.mjs`. The extracted monogram stays internal to the script (favicon chip + OG composition) and is never shipped as a standalone logo file. `og.jpg` (1200×630) is regenerated by the script — never cropped, recompressed or edited by hand.
- Palette: `accent-500` is official (logo field). `flare` `#E2631B` and `bright` `#F0D711` remain **provisional** references sampled from the capability-statement cover (content-open-items item 14). Vector artwork and a reversed/mono variant are still outstanding (item 4); the extracted header monogram is a **derivative of the official mark, not a supplied variant**, and stays flagged for SES approval.
- Tokens live in `src/styles/global.css` `@theme`. Components consume tokens only (`accent-*`, `ink-*`, `flare`, `bright`, `line`, `muted`, `body`, `paper`) — never hard-code hex in components. Sole exception: the `theme-color` meta in `BaseLayout.astro` (meta tags cannot use CSS variables); it must mirror `ink-950` and is re-checked on every retheme.

## Palette law

| Token | Value | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accent-500` | `#D69C1F` amber gold (official logo field) | CTA fills, eyebrow rules, selection |
| `accent-700` | `#8b6514` bronze (derived) | Accent text on light (5.3:1) |
| `accent-600` | `#af8019` deep amber (derived) | Icons on light (3.5:1) |
| `accent-400` | `#ddac43` light amber (derived) | Accent text/icons on dark (9.1:1) |
| `accent-300` | `#e5c172` pale amber (derived) | Large accent text on dark (11:1) |
| `flare` | `#E2631B` orange (provisional ref) | Hover "heat-up", gradient partner only |
| `bright` | `#F0D711` yellow (provisional ref) | Non-text signature marks only |
| `ink-950` | `#12100F` near-black (official ref) | Dark surfaces, primary text |
| `muted` | `#575B61` slate (official ref) | Secondary text on light (6.8:1) |
| `line` | `#DCDFE4` light grey (official ref) | Hairlines, borders |
| `paper`/`paper-2` | `#F8F7F4`/`#EFEEEA` (derived) | Section alternation |

Amber `accent-500` on `ink-950` ≈ 7.8:1 — amber fills always carry `ink-950` text. Derived ramps are working tints/shades of the official anchor — not official specifications.

## Contrast law (WCAG 2.1 AA — non-negotiable)

1. **Never white text/icons on amber, orange or yellow** (white-on-amber ≈ 2.2:1).
2. On amber/orange fills, text and icons are `ink-950` (7.8:1 amber, 5.2:1 orange).
3. Accent text on light = `accent-700`; accent text on dark = `accent-400`/`accent-300`.
4. Focus rings: bronze (≥3:1 on light and dark). Selection: amber background, `ink-950` text.
5. Body text `body` on white; `muted` only for supporting text ≥14px.

## Colour discipline (Ander-inspired restraint)

- One dominant accent: amber. Everything else is ink, paper and grey. If a section seems to need a second accent, redesign the section.
- **One `flare-bar` per viewport** (bright→amber→orange signature divider, footer's top edge). Never stack two in view; never place text on it.
- Bright yellow never appears as text or thin strokes — only inside the flare-bar and future signature marks.
- Orange is a motion colour (hover heat-up), never a resting fill.
- Dark bands are warm near-black (`ink-950`/`ink-900`) — never pure black, never cool navy.

## Logo treatment

- Master lockup: amber field + black monogram (silver gears) + wordmark + services tagline. The printed tagline is brand evidence, not site copy — see `ses-content-case-study` before echoing it anywhere.
- Dark surfaces: the black-lettering monogram rides on a white chip (implemented in `Logo.astro`, paired with the typeset "SIBANYE / Engineering Solutions" lockup). Light surfaces: the mark rides directly on paper.
- Monogram aspect 1072:746 (rendered 517×360); min height 32px; clear space ≥ the "S" height.
- Raster-only until vector arrives: do not exceed ~517px wide or use in print (item 4).

## Typography

- Display: Space Grotesk (headings, numerals, buttons); text: Inter (body, forms). Self-hosted via Fontsource — no third-party font CDNs.
- Editorial scale jump: hero ~72/64 → section heads 36/30 → card titles 20/18 → body 16 → metadata 12px uppercase tracked. `tracking-tight` on display sizes only.

## Ander Group principles — transfer, never copy

Adopt: strategic clarity, one idea per section, numbered section rhythm, hairline rules over boxes, generous whitespace, single-accent discipline, restrained purposeful motion (staggered reveals, view transitions, the gear watermark), case-study storytelling, quiet confident footer. Forbidden: copying Ander layouts/text/imagery/logo treatment/section designs; decorative gradients beyond the flare-bar; glassmorphism; emoji iconography; accent stacking.

## Governance

- Every new component/page passes the checklist before commit.
- Palette provenance: amber anchor official (logo-supplied 2026-10-22, ADR-013); flare/bright provisional until the SES brand guide arrives. When it does: update tokens + this agent, rerun the contrast table, log an ADR in `docs/DECISIONS.md`. Provisional labels come off only with written SES verification.
- Flag deviation requests in `docs/content-open-items.md`; never resolve silently.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] No white-on-amber/orange/yellow (audit every `bg-accent-500`/`bg-flare` sibling text class)
- [ ] Accent text: `accent-700` on light, `accent-400`/`accent-300` on dark
- [ ] Bronze focus-visible everywhere; skip-link compliant
- [ ] Max one flare-bar per viewport; yellow confined to non-text marks
- [ ] Tokens only — no raw hex in `.astro` files
- [ ] Logo derivatives regenerated only via `scripts/process-logo.mjs`; master untouched; white-chip treatment intact on dark
- [ ] `og.jpg` regenerated by the script; OG meta dimensions accurate (1200×630, large card)
- [ ] Provisional caveats documented (items 4 and 14) until SES verifies
- [ ] `npm run build` green after any token change
